observations.rule: PHP documents empty POST and FILES when posted data exceeds post_max_size; the supplied confirmed lengths identify that condition.

optionAudit.file-error: No per-file entry is available to inspect.
optionAudit.body-limit: Recognizes the whole-body boundary before interpreting empty parsed data.
optionAudit.success-empty: The confirmed length fits the file limit but violates the smaller POST limit.

observations.rule: PDO prepare documentation requires a unique parameter marker for each value occurrence unless emulation is enabled; this scenario explicitly retains native MySQL prepares.

optionAudit.separate: Two distinct markers are each assigned 7.
optionAudit.bind-twice: Reassigns one named binding without fixing repeated markers.
optionAudit.array-value: A marker represents one scalar value, not an array expansion.
optionAudit.quote-one: The quoted marker becomes literal SQL text.

observations.rule: The supplied schedule changes filesystem state between check and open; only the open result determines whether a usable stream exists.

optionAudit.clear-cache: A fresh precheck still precedes the deletion.
optionAudit.repeat-check: Deletion can follow the final check.

observations.rule: MySQL 8.4 ALTER TABLE causes implicit commits; ordinary InnoDB business writes can be rolled back only while their transaction remains uncommitted.

optionAudit.catch-earlier: Does not reverse the DDL-triggered commit.
optionAudit.autocommit-off: Does not disable implicit commits for ALTER TABLE.
optionAudit.separate-schema: Removes the committing statement from the business unit of work.

observations.rule: The importer’s stated normalization determines destination identity; uniqueness must be checked over those complete normalized paths before extraction.

optionAudit.reject-parent: Rejects the required valid single-entry case.
optionAudit.canonical: Rejects exactly the collision while preserving both valid cases.

observations.rule: RFC 9110 defines 307 method preservation and 303 retrieval of another resource following the original request.

optionAudit.see-other: Selects the retrieval redirect semantics required by the scenario.
optionAudit.permanent: 308 does not change POST into GET.

observations.rule: cURL follows Location targets when configured to do so; the application’s origin allowlist must apply to redirected requests as well.

optionAudit.initial-sufficient: Allows a remote response to choose an unauthorized origin.
optionAudit.https-protects: The premise allows HTTP redirect targets.
optionAudit.revalidate: Checks or prevents the additional outbound action.

observations.rule: libcurl defines CONNECTTIMEOUT_MS in milliseconds and TIMEOUT_MS as the maximum time for the whole transfer, including connection time.

optionAudit.seconds-connect: Sets the connection option in seconds.
optionAudit.both-ms: Sets exactly the two required budgets.

observations.rule: Composer check-platform-reqs checks the real platform and ignores config.platform; --no-dev restricts the check to production requirements.

optionAudit.actual-platform: Detects the real missing ext-intl requirement.
optionAudit.manifest: Validates metadata, not the requested runtime capability gate.
optionAudit.autoload: Builds lookup metadata rather than checking the real platform.

observations.rule: The scenario defines asynchronous replication with unbounded lag and a confirmed available primary; only the primary route guarantees this immediate observation.

optionAudit.primary-confirmation: Reads from the node with the confirmed committed row.
optionAudit.fixed-sleep: No stated lag bound justifies the delay.

observations.rule: The stated API assigns different operations to absent, present-null and present-string inputs; a representation must preserve all three states.
Revocations committed before execution must apply; enqueue-time decisions and snapshots are insufficient even when authentic.

optionAudit.current-policy: Observes the required current authorization state.
optionAudit.signature-again: Checks integrity without freshness of authority.

observations.rule: The scenario permits recomputation but forbids cross-version payload interpretation; key namespaces must separate concurrent incompatible formats.

optionAudit.flush-once: Old workers repopulate shared keys after the purge.
optionAudit.short-ttl: Still permits incompatible reads before expiration.
optionAudit.writer-timestamp: Does not supply a compatible representation.
optionAudit.versioned-keys: Separates both readers and writers by schema version.

observations.rule: PHP supports one parent class and multiple implemented interfaces; traits are not object types for parameter contracts.

optionAudit.interface: Adds the required method contract without changing class ancestry.
optionAudit.trait-type: Cannot establish the requested nominal type.
optionAudit.method-names: Does not make the object parameter enforce the signatures.

observations.rule: Under the stated 100-slot model, a hard A cap of 80 plus a B reservation prevents A from exhausting B capacity before failure detection.

optionAudit.shorter-timeout: Allows full occupancy until the shorter timeout.
optionAudit.failure-breaker: Requires observations that may not yet exist.
optionAudit.retry-jitter: Does not limit the initial burst.

observations.rule: PostgreSQL documents SQLSTATE 40001 and requires retrying the complete transaction, including logic that chooses statements and values.

optionAudit.whole-operation: Recreates a coherent transactional attempt from fresh observations.
optionAudit.failed-statement: Omits prior work and its decision context.

observations.rule: Composer documents both plugin and script execution and recommends sandboxing untrusted dependencies; the scenario explicitly requires hooks and separates artifact approval.

optionAudit.scripts-only-off: Read-only deployment credentials are still exposed to reads.
optionAudit.ordinary-user: Production access remains available despite the explicit prohibition.
optionAudit.isolated-builder: Permits hooks within the stated isolation and promotion boundaries.
